title: linum armenum
intro: Linum armenum, commonly known as Armenian silk, is a flowering plant species in the family Linaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Linum armenum are attributed to its ability to soothe anxiety, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
